definition: A powerful feeling of disgust or sudden rejection.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: At that moment something seemed to sting Raskolnikov; in an instant a complete revulsion of feeling came over him.
example_sentence: She recoiled in revulsion from the mouldy sandwich.
